svg.text: LangGraph 0 · Where LangGraph is used, and why
Rule: LangGraph when a workflow pauses for a person, runs AI calls in parallel, or loops. A straight line of steps is plain Python. Diagrams 1 to 5 show each graph with its real nodes.
LangGraph (7 graphs in app/graphs/ + the agent)
Agent loop: choose a tool, read the result, choose again
Loop: revise once after the code check
Pause (interrupt) for Yes / No; survives a restart
Loops (OCR, retry) + pause for include / exclude
Pause until Send; Write again (+ change) loops back
Six AI graders in parallel (fan-out / fan-in)
Four steps in parallel + repair loop (max 2)
Loop: retry once, then the standard text
Straight line of 5 steps: no pause, loop or parallel steps
8 steps, only one AI step: run one after another
Same in every workflow: the AI suggests, code checks (quotes, rules, scores), a person decides. Every run is logged in workflow_run; every AI call is logged with its tokens.
